title: AdaMix over logical Mirror adaptations
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 QKV LoRA basis with two stochastic rank-space Givens views can preserve the per-view and merged quality of two-branch AdaMix over two text domains at no more than 75% of AdaMix bank bytes and beat matched-byte FiLM by 0.02 mean nat.

mirror_insertion.physical_object: one rank-4 A/B low-rank update on every layer's nanoGPT attention QKV projection
mirror_insertion.coordinate: six trainable Givens angles per layer and view, acting in the rank-4 latent space
mirror_insertion.logical_functions: two per-view adapter realizations and one merged single-module deployment
mirror_insertion.route: uniformly sample one of two view IDs per adaptation minibatch; base and shared basis train, only the selected view code receives view-specific gradient
mirror_insertion.native_delta: AdaMix uses two independently parameterized rank-4 QKV LoRA branches with the same stochastic minibatch route schedule

domains.name: Tiny Shakespeare
domains.train_use: base pretraining and 50% of adaptation batches

data.acquisition: Download only after preregistration; record exact byte length and SHA-256 for both files.
data.split: For each raw byte stream independently: [0,80%) train; [80,90%) development; [90,100%) audit. Use separate token windows within each span, never crossing boundaries. Character vocabulary is the union of both training spans only; unseen dev/audit characters map to one fixed UNK.
data.audit_access: Do not decode, tokenize, evaluate, or report per-example information from either audit span unless every development gate passes in both seeds. Whole-file SHA-256 may be streamed for provenance.

model.implementation: thin adapter wrapping third_party/nanoGPT/model.py; do not modify the vendor tree
model.adapter_target: attn.c_attn QKV projection in every block
model.mirror_view: six pairwise Givens rotations in rank-4 latent space
model.film_control: four diagonal rank scales per layer and view

conditions: one conventional rank-4 LoRA trained with every minibatch
AdaMix: two independent rank-4 LoRA branches; uniformly sample one branch per minibatch
Mirror: one shared rank-4 A/B basis and two per-layer Givens View codes; uniformly sample one view per minibatch
FiLM: one shared rank-4 A/B basis and two per-layer diagonal rank scales; uniformly sample one view per minibatch

training.adapter_optimizer: AdamW; frozen base; train only adapter parameters and Mirror/FiLM codes
training.adaptation_sampling: each update selects Shakespeare or Pride and Prejudice with probability 0.5; AdaMix/Mirror/FiLM also sample one of two routes/views uniformly using a separate deterministic RNG stream. Expected branch/view exposure is 300 of 600 minibatches; actual route counts are recorded.
training.checkpoint_rule: fixed final update; no dev-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection

metrics: per-view development next-character NLL separately for each domain
mean per-view development NLL across both domains and both views
merged single-module NLL separately per domain and mean across domains
actual serialized full inference-bank payload bytes and SHA-256
actual merged model payload bytes and SHA-256
base and adapter training examples/tokens, updates, single-thread CPU wall time
active QKV LoRA MAC proxy and evaluation tokens/second
view-pair functional output/logit distance on the same fixed dev minibatch

merge.AdaMix: exact arithmetic mean of the two dense low-rank delta matrices, folded into the frozen base QKV weights
merge.Mirror: exact arithmetic mean of B R(m_i) A across the two codes, folded into the frozen base QKV weights
merge.FiLM: exact arithmetic mean of B diag(s_i) A, folded into the frozen base QKV weights
merge.single_lora: fold its one delta into the frozen base QKV weights
merge.storage: serialize merged models separately; for multi-view inference-bank byte comparisons, count base plus every retained component and code

gates.quality_vs_adamix: In both seeds, Mirror mean per-view NLL and mean merged NLL must each be <= AdaMix +0.10 nat.
gates.storage: In both seeds, complete Mirror two-view inference-bank payload must be <=0.99x complete AdaMix two-view bank payload AND adapter-only serialized bytes must be <=0.55x AdaMix; report both full and incremental payload axes.
gates.mirror_specific: In both seeds, Mirror mean per-view NLL and mean merged NLL must each beat matched-byte FiLM by >=0.02 nat. If full bank payloads differ by >5%, report the comparison unmatched and fail this gate.
gates.audit: Open both locked audit spans only if all development gates pass in both seeds. Use unchanged models and no tuning.

paid_objects: all retained adapter bases or independent adapters

compute.hardware: single-thread CPU (CUDA not available in selected container)

boundaries: This is a low-resource two-domain mechanism screen, not a general PEFT or language-model claim.
AdaMix implementation reproduces its stochastic branch selection and mean-update merge at this small nanoGPT scale; it is not the paper's large-model benchmark reproduction.
A fixed-update result is not a capacity result.
Averaging separate adapters and averaging Mirror Views are evaluated as merged models; merged quality does not imply the individual logical views are independently capable.
